_note: MOCK clean-food sellers (farms, organic co-ops, bakeries, natural care) for the prototype. Names are invented; prices are approximate (JOD); 'organic' is a seller label only, not a health claim. 'for' lists what each item replaces: food categories (processed_meat, red_meat, refined_grain, sugary_drink, snack, dairy, other, wholegrain), carcinogen ids from src/lib/carcinogens.js, or non-food concern ids from scoring.js.
